game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Island Ferry Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Coastal Port – Island Ferry, the island ferry landing: the sailor must handle kraken tentacles while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Island Ferry: the island ferry landing
core_gameplay_loop: In Island Ferry, repeat each round: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions. Each round, a new anchors challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the cover value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 380 points of anchors by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 380, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 8 (extended tier): Patrol Decision Tree
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Patrol Decision Tree' (Week 3 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Island Ferry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cover changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against kraken tentacles in Island Ferry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 380 within 51 seconds.
